title: Public Taylor impact benchmark API
objective: Expose the public Taylor impact benchmark parameter object and runner after the runtime surface is proven.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E8 public Taylor benchmark API scope.

scope: Add run_taylor_impact_benchmark to the benchmark package.
Provide smoke and nightly configuration knobs.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact before editing benchmark package exports.
Add the public Taylor benchmark module and parameter dataclass.
Wire the runner to the internal Taylor runtime.
Export the public API from the benchmarks package.
acceptance_criteria: TaylorImpactParameters exposes deterministic smoke settings and full/nightly settings.
No shared benchmark result schema changes are required.
risks: Taylor public API can lock in an unstable runtime shape; mitigate by exposing only the minimum parameters needed for smoke and nightly settings.
completion_notes: Added mechdsl.verify.benchmarks.taylor_impact (TaylorImpactParameters + run_taylor_impact_benchmark) composing the Phase 7 internal runtime into a deterministic public runner.
Maps Taylor metrics into BenchmarkResult.extras (final_length, mushroom_radius, mushroom_diameter=2*radius, peak_peeq + telemetry); BenchmarkResult schema reused verbatim.
smoke()/nightly() classmethods mirror CantileverParameters; smoke profile runs in ~0.1s (2x2x8 mesh / 10 steps), nightly in O(seconds) (6x6x20 / 400 steps).

Smoke determinism verified across 5 consecutive runs (bit-for-bit). 5 parameter validation modes (impact_velocity sign, dt non-positive, dimensions non-positive, element_type non-Hex8, wall behind bar) all raise ValueError with field-named messages.
dt=2e-8 sized at ~30x safety margin vs dt_crit=6.3e-7 for the steel-calibrated smoke mesh — addresses Phase 7 P7-2 wave-physics carry-forward.
P10-7 stubs in test_taylor_impact.py deliberately untouched (P8-2 owns activation).
